note: The larger, mostly open campground at Mashamoquet Brook State Park, with the camp office at its entrance off Wolf Den Drive; sites ring a single loop. Pets not allowed. Pond swimming is no longer available since the pond was drained (ReserveAmerica, read 2026-11-11). --Claude
